basic_info.description: Charming Golden Gate Heights home filled with natural light throughout! Enjoy stunning bay and city views from multiple front windows. The top floor features a spacious east-facing living room, dining area, kitchen, full bath, and a bedroom plus an additional dining room staged as a second bedroom. Both rooms offer direct access to a large rear deck, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The ground floor includes a one-car garage and ample storage space. Conveniently located just blocks from the vibrant 9th & Irving Street shops and restaurants, UCSF Medical Center, Golden Gate Park, Academy of Science, de Young Museum, Conservatory of Flowers, Mount Sutro hiking trails, Grandview Park, and Forest Hill. The interior has been freshly painted, and the existing hardwood floors were recently refinished. This adorable home is the perfect condo alternative with its own private yard!
